notes.title: Transfer progress between Nintendo Switch and PC
notes.content:
This update allows you to transfer your progress between Induction on PC and Nintendo Switch.

To transfer progress:
[list]
[*] Open the pause menu on the device you want to transfer progress [b]from[/b]
[*] Go to the Data screen, and note down the 8 character code at the bottom of the screen
[*] Open the pause menu on the device you want to transfer progress [b]to[/b]
[*] Go to the Data screen, and enter the 8 character code you noted down
[/list]
All levels unlocked on the first device will now be unlocked on the second device. Solution replays will not though be transferred.

If you experience any problems with this update, please let me know on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/381890/discussions/]discussion board[/url], or contact me at support@inductiongame.com.

notes.title: Induction Update 1.1.2
notes.content:
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Add support for French, Dutch, Portuguese, Canadian French, Latin American Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, and Traditional Chinese
[*] Replays show your most recent success (thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/FIle_xor]File_xor[/url] for helping me realise my logic for taking the "fastest" replay didn't make sense)
[*] Can slow down replays on level select
[*] Very minor animation, input, and tutorial tweaks
[/list]

If you experience any problems with this update, please let me know on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/381890/discussions/]discussion board[/url], or contact me at support@inductiongame.com.

notes.title: Induction Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Grid option available in 'Video' settings
[*] Credits music respects volume settings
[*] Fix a minor bug where rewind ability wouldn't be unlocked early if used on the fourth level
[/list]

If you experience any problems with this update, please let me know on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/381890/discussions/]discussion board[/url], or contact me at support@inductiongame.com.

notes.title: Induction Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
This update moves Induction to the latest stable version of the Unity engine, which means the desktop version of Induction will be in sync with ports to other platforms, coming later this year.

Unfortunately this means version 1.1.0 will not support some older operating systems. If you're affected by this, the "legacy" 1.0.5 version of Induction will still be available - right click Induction in your Steam library, select "Properties...", select "Betas", then select the "legacy" branch.

This update makes a few other small changes.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Minor redesign the the level select interface
[*] Game is no longer letterboxed to 16:9
[*] Faster loading
[*] Additional translations to German and Korean
[*] Credits are accessible through the "About" menu
[*] When using a gamepad, the right stick can be used to control time flow, in addition to shoulder buttons
[*] Time portals more accurately show revealed timeline
[*] Fix a bug that could cause replays to sometimes not play
[/list]

If you experience any problems with this update, please let me know on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/381890/discussions/]discussion board[/url], or contact me at support@inductiongame.com.
